name: Shankarpali
subtitle: sweet fried diamonds of flour and semolina, made by the tinful at Diwali

ingredients.note: the semolina is what gives the bite

prepNotes: Fry on low. This is the one rule; shankarpali browned fast is raw in the middle and goes soft the next day.
The dough should be firm, closer to pastry than to chapati dough.

steps.text: Warm the milk with the sugar until it dissolves, then cool. Stir in the melted ghee.
Work in the flour, rava, cardamom and salt to a firm dough. Rest 20 minutes.
Roll out 4mm thick and cut into diamonds.
Fry on genuinely low heat, turning often, for about 8 minutes until pale gold throughout.
steps.tip: Low and slow. If they colour in three minutes the oil is too hot.

steps.text: Drain and cool completely before storing.

storage: Keeps 3 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature.
